entities.name: Helga
entities.description: A frogfolk augur who confronts her former master, frees herself with a water-step spell, and decides to stay in Goodhill as a hedgewitch.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: A mousefolk baker and swordswoman whose fang-sword bursts into flame, who spares Cruelclaw and returns the egg to Maha.

entities.name: King Glarb
entities.description: The frogfolk king of Fountainport and Helga's former master, who tries to control the Calamity Beast within a stolen egg, and flees.

entities.name: Cruelclaw
entities.description: A scarred weaselfolk mercenary of the Direshade Company who stole the egg for King Glarb and escapes.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker turned otterfolk who helps in the fight and leaves Bloomburrow by teleporting away.

entities.name: Finneas
entities.description: A rabbitfolk archer who fights skunkfolk with burr-tipped arrows.

entities.name: Hugs
entities.description: A badgerfolk fighter.

entities.name: Gev
entities.description: A lizardfolk fire-mace fighter.

entities.name: Zoraline
entities.description: A batfolk cleric.

entities.name: Clem
entities.description: Mabel's husband, who welcomes her home.

entities.name: Rosalyn
entities.description: Mabel's eldest child.

entities.name: Pip
entities.description: Mabel's youngest child.

entities.name: Foggy
entities.description: One of Mabel's children.

entities.name: Oliver
entities.description: The mayor of Goodhill who gives a welcome-home speech.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The planeswalker Ral is hunting.

entities.name: Tomik
entities.description: Ral's husband, for whom Mabel gives a button.

entities.name: Maha, the Night Owl
entities.description: The Calamity Beast whose egg was stolen; it defeats the Storm Hawk and takes back its egg.

entities.name: The Storm Hawk
entities.description: A four-winged, lightning-wreathed dragon from another plane in animal form, who attacks Fountainport and is driven off by Maha.

entities.name: The Flood Gar
entities.description: A Calamity Beast that drowned the Docklands in Three Tree City.

entities.name: Calamity Beast egg
entities.description: A large velvety blue egg with starry specks, held in a lattice nest in King Glarb's throne room.

entities.name: Direshade Company
entities.description: The mercenary company led by Cruelclaw that fights for King Glarb.

entities.name: Fountainport
entities.description: King Glarb's lofty three-tiered soapstone city over Valley's largest pond.

entities.name: Goodhill
entities.description: Mabel's home town where the party returns to a parade.

entities.name: Three Tree City
entities.description: The city whose docklands were drowned.

entities.name: Ever-Burning Oak
entities.description: A place Gev wants to holiday at.

entities.name: The fang-sword
entities.description: Mabel's flame-wreathed sword.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Natural-disaster beasts that Glarb wishes to command.

entities.name: Lorekeepers
entities.description: The ratfolk who also search for the egg.

events.summary: Helga leads her companions up through Fountainport to seek an audience with King Glarb, her former master.
events.quote: In theory, we ask his aides for an audience.

events.summary: Helga recounts how she was dismissed after accidentally hitting King Glarb with his own water whip and staff.
events.quote: He spent days recovering from the concussion. And the staff broke.

events.summary: The party is admitted to the throne room and tells King Glarb about the attacks and Cruelclaw's theft.
events.quote: A weaselfolk called Cruelclaw stole a Calamity Beast egg

events.summary: Helga pulls aside a screen and reveals the Calamity Beast egg, which King Glarb says he paid Cruelclaw to bring.
events.quote: "I paid Cruelclaw extremely well to bring it here."

events.summary: King Glarb reveals his plan to control the Calamity Beast within the egg as a champion for Valley.
events.quote: with the right weaving, I can control the Calamity Beast within that egg.

events.summary: King Glarb binds the party and orders Cruelclaw's Direshades to kill them, mocking Helga as a failure.
Helga, encouraged by Mabel, uses a water-step spell to send Cruelclaw sliding into the king, breaking the bonds.
events.quote: With a jerk of her chin, she sent him sliding toward King Glarb

events.summary: A battle breaks out in the throne room between the party and the Direshades.
events.quote: Every enemy who sought to strike her found only empty air as her magic obscured her movements.

events.summary: Mabel fights Cruelclaw, her sword bursts into flame, and she disarms him and spares his life.
King Glarb freezes Helga in ice and Mabel melts it, and the king rises on a water platform as a storm gathers.
events.quote: jammed her flaming blade into the frozen block.

events.summary: The Storm Hawk dives at King Glarb, who escapes by portal.
events.quote: From between streaks of electricity, the Storm Hawk emerged with a deafening roar.

events.summary: Mabel climbs Helga's water steps to the stone lily and challenges the Storm Hawk, but Maha, the Night Owl, strikes it first.
events.quote: struck by a new foe: Maha, the Night Owl, trailing a curtain of darkness.

events.summary: Maha drives off the Storm Hawk, taking all remnants of foul weather with it.
events.quote: The Night Owl's talons closed on the Storm Hawk's tail feathers, wrenching one free.

events.summary: Mabel carries the egg to the Night Owl and returns it, calming the Calamity Beast.
events.quote: The Night Owl gingerly took the egg.

events.summary: King Glarb leaves Fountainport and Cruelclaw escapes, while the party heads home.
events.quote: King Glarb not only fled the immediate area, he left Fountainport entirely, his whereabouts unknown.

events.summary: The returning heroes are welcomed with a parade in Goodhill, and Oliver gives another speech.
events.quote: treating their arrival as an impromptu parade.

events.summary: Helga decides to stay in Goodhill as a hedgewitch and is called a hero.
events.quote: I thought maybe I could … stay here? As a hedgewitch

events.summary: Helga speaks a prophecy that the kings in the dark will return and the mage in blue will bring about the end.
events.quote: "The kings in the dark will return," she intoned. "The mage in blue will bring about the end."

events.summary: Mabel gives Ral two holly-leaf buttons for him and his husband, and Ral vanishes in lightning.
events.quote: Ral vanished in an explosion of lightning sparks that lit the evening

relations.note: Helga was King Glarb's apprentice before being dismissed.
King Glarb hired Cruelclaw to bring him the egg.
relations.quote: I paid Cruelclaw extremely well to bring it here.

relations.note: Cruelclaw heads the Direshade Company mercenaries.
relations.quote: "The Direshade Company fulfills its contracts," Cruelclaw said
drew her husband and daughter into the family hug.

relations.note: Mabel encourages Helga to believe in herself.
relations.quote: "Don't listen to him, Helga," Mabel insisted.

relations.note: The Night Owl attacks and drives off the Storm Hawk.
relations.quote: The Night Owl's talons closed on the Storm Hawk's tail feathers

relations.note: Mabel gives Ral buttons for him and his husband.
relations.quote: "For you and your husband," she said

relations.note: The egg belongs to Maha, who takes it back from Mabel.
relations.quote: "This is yours, isn't it?" Mabel murmured.
